nodes.title: Trello REST API request
nodes.description: Call any Trello REST API endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/boards/{board_id}/actions". Only the API's own host is allowed. Agent tools may only read boards, lists, cards, checklists, labels, actions, organizations, search and members (no tokens, webhooks or applications, and no tokens or webhooks query keys).

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/boards/{board_id}/actions"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
